'''Boneknit''' is an [[herb]] known for its healing properties, specifically when used to heal broken bones. [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] references the herb in a discussion with [[Ailhuin Guenna]] in [[Tear]], though they each know it by a different name.{{ref/book|3|48}} This suggests that the plant is one that grows over a large portion of the continent.
